blurb.en: A node that holds a value and two children, a small tree wired together by hand, and two recursive functions that count its nodes and measure its height.
blurb.zh: 一个节点装一个值和两个孩子；手工把一棵小树连起来，再用两个递归函数数出它有几个节点、量出它有多高。

en: Recursion itself - base cases, the recursive step, the call stack - is on the Recursion page; here it is simply the natural way to ask a tree a question. A tree is either empty (None) or a node with a left subtree and a right subtree, and each subtree is a smaller tree of exactly the same kind.

Building the tree by hand shows what the class really stores: each TreeNode keeps a value and two references, and a missing child is just None. The root A holds B and C; B holds D and E; C has nothing on its left and F on its right. Nothing in the class marks a node as the root - it is simply the one no other node points to.

count_nodes says: an empty tree has no nodes; otherwise it is the nodes of the left subtree, plus those of the right subtree, plus this one. height has the same shape but keeps only the taller of the two sides before adding this node's own level. With this convention an empty tree has height 0 and a single node height 1; some textbooks count edges instead, which makes every height one smaller.
The last tree, G, H, I, has every node hanging off the left of the one above it, so it has as many levels as nodes. A tree does not have to be bushy, and how bushy it is decides how tall it gets.
zh: 递归本身（基例、递归步、调用栈）见「递归」一页；这里它只是向一棵树提问最自然的写法。一棵树要么是空的（None），要么是一个节点带着一棵左子树和一棵右子树——而每棵子树又是一棵同样的、更小的树。
手工建树能看清这个类到底存了什么：每个 TreeNode 存一个值和两个引用，缺的孩子就是 None。根 A 挂着 B 和 C；B 挂着 D 和 E；C 左边空着、右边是 F。类里没有任何东西标明哪个节点是根——根只不过是没有别的节点指向它的那一个。
count_nodes 说的是：空树没有节点；否则就是左子树的节点数，加右子树的节点数，再加上自己这一个。height 的形状一样，只是两边只留更高的那一边，再加上自己这一层。按这个约定，空树高 0、单个节点高 1；有的教材数的是边，那样每个高度都小 1。
最后那棵 G、H、I，每个节点都挂在上一个的左边，所以节点有几个、层就有几层。树不一定枝繁叶茂，而它长得多茂密，决定了它有多高。

lineNotes.en: The children are built first so that they can be handed in when their parent is made.
lineNotes.zh: 孩子先建好，造父节点时才能把它们传进去。

lineNotes.en: An empty tree on its own: both functions stop at their first return.
lineNotes.zh: 单独问一棵空树：两个函数都在第一个 return 就停下。

run.expect:
A B C
E F None
6 3
3 2
1 1
0 0

blurb.en: Preorder, inorder and postorder: three recursive functions that differ only in where the node's own value goes.
blurb.zh: 前序、中序、后序：三个递归函数，差别只在节点自己的值放在哪里。

en: Recursion itself - base cases, the recursive step, the call stack - is on the Recursion page; this page only uses it. The tree is a binary search tree built by inserting the values one at a time with the insert from BST Insert (Recursive); a repeated value is ignored.

Every traversal visits each node once and answers in the same way: an empty tree gives an empty list; otherwise join three lists - the left subtree's, this node's value on its own, and the right subtree's. The only difference between the three functions is where this node's value sits: first (preorder), in the middle (inorder) or last (postorder).

Inorder on a binary search tree gives the values in ascending order, because everything smaller is on the left and everything larger on the right. Preorder lists every parent before its children - inserting values in that order rebuilds the same shape. Postorder finishes both children before their parent, the order to use when a node's answer depends on its children's.
Inserting 1, 2, 3 in that order makes a chain that leans right, so preorder and inorder come out the same and postorder is the reverse.
zh: 递归本身（基例、递归步、调用栈）见「递归」一页；本页只是用它。这棵树是二叉搜索树：用 「二叉搜索树插入（递归）」里的 insert 把值逐个插进去；重复的值不插。
每种遍历都把每个节点访问一次，回答的方式也一样：空树给空列表；否则把三段列表连起来——左子树的、单独的自己这个值、右子树的。三个函数之间唯一的差别，是自己的值放在哪一段：最前（前序）、中间（中序）、最后（后序）。
二叉搜索树的中序给出从小到大的值，因为比它小的都在左边、比它大的都在右边。前序总是先列父节点再列孩子——按这个顺序重新插入，能建回同样形状的树。后序在父节点之前先走完两个孩子，节点的答案要靠孩子的答案时就用这个顺序。
按顺序插入 1、2、3 会得到一条往右斜的链，于是前序和中序一模一样，后序正好反过来。

lineNotes.en: The model for the other two: this node's value in a one-item list, joined to the two subtrees' lists with +.
lineNotes.zh: 另外两个照它写：自己的值包成单元素列表，与两棵子树的列表用 + 连起来。

lineNotes.en: Three values separated by commas: the function returns one tuple of three lists.
lineNotes.zh: 逗号隔开的三个值：函数返回的是装着三个列表的一个元组。

blurb.en: The same three traversals with no function calling itself: a list used as a stack remembers where to go back to.
blurb.zh: 同样三种遍历，没有一个函数调用自己：一个当栈用的列表记住该回到哪里。

en: The same tree and the same three orders as Tree Traversals (Recursive), but nothing calls itself while walking the tree: the list stack does the remembering that the call stack did there. (The tree is still built with the recursive insert; recursion itself is on the Recursion page.)

Preorder pops a node, records it and pushes its two children. The right child goes on first so that the left one comes off first. Missing children are pushed as None as well and skipped when they are popped, which keeps the loop short.

Inorder cannot record a node when it first meets it: the whole left subtree has to come first. So it goes left as far as it can, pushing every node on the way. When it runs out, the node on top of the stack is the next one in order; it is recorded, and the walk moves into its right subtree, where the same thing starts again.

Postorder uses two stacks. The first is processed like preorder but with the left child pushed first, so the second stack collects each node before its right and then its left subtree. Read from the top down, the second stack gives left, right, then the node - postorder.
zh: 与 「树的遍历（递归）」同一棵树、同样三种顺序，但走树时没有一个函数调用自己：那边调用栈替你记住的东西，这里由列表 stack 来记。（建树仍用递归的 insert；递归本身见「递归」一页。）
前序：弹出一个节点、记下它、再把它的两个孩子压栈。右孩子先压，左孩子才会先弹出来。缺的孩子也照样作为 None 压进去，弹出来时跳过——循环因此很短。
中序不能在第一次遇到节点时就记下它：它的整棵左子树得排在前面。所以先一路向左走到头，沿途每个节点都压栈。走不下去时，栈顶那个就是中序里的下一个；记下它，然后转进它的右子树，在那里重来一遍。
后序用两个栈。第一个栈像前序那样处理，只是先压左孩子，于是第二个栈里攒下的是每个节点、再是它的右子树、再是左子树。从栈顶往下读第二个栈，就是左、右、节点自己——后序。

lineNotes.at: while stack or node is not None:
lineNotes.en: Carry on while there is either a remembered node on the stack or a subtree still to walk into.
lineNotes.zh: 栈里还有记着的节点，或者还有一棵子树没走进去，就继续。

lineNotes.en: Inorder records a node only when it comes off the stack, once everything to its left is already done.
lineNotes.zh: 中序要等节点从栈里弹出来才记下它——那时它左边的都已经走完。

blurb.en: Put each value into a binary search tree by handing it to the left or right subtree, and read the resulting shape off in preorder.
blurb.zh: 把每个值交给左子树或右子树去插，插完用前序读出树的形状。

en: Recursion itself - base cases, the recursive step, the call stack - is on the Recursion page; here it follows the shape of the tree. A binary search tree keeps one rule at every node: everything in its left subtree is smaller, everything in its right subtree is larger.

insert answers the question: what does this subtree look like once value is in it? An empty subtree becomes a single new node. Otherwise the value goes into the left or the right subtree, and that subtree - which may be brand new - is stored back into the node. The node itself is still the root of its subtree, so that is what goes back to the caller.

Storing the result back at every level looks like wasted work, since only the lowest one actually changes anything. It is what lets the empty-subtree case create the node without ever knowing its parent.
A value equal to one already in the tree fails both comparisons and changes nothing, so this tree keeps no duplicates.

The preorder list shows the shape. The first two demo lines insert the same values in a different order and get different trees. Inserting 1, 2, 3, 4 in order makes each node the right child of the one before - a tree that is really a linked list.
zh: 递归本身（基例、递归步、调用栈）见「递归」一页；这里它顺着树的形状走。二叉搜索树在每个节点上守一条规矩：左子树里的都比它小，右子树里的都比它大。
insert 回答的问题是：把 value 放进去之后，这棵子树长什么样？空子树变成一个新节点。否则值进左子树或右子树，再把那棵子树（可能是刚造出来的）存回节点上。节点本身仍是这棵子树的根，所以交回给调用者的就是它。
每一层都把结果存回去，看上去做了白工——真正改变东西的只有最底下那一层。可正是这样，空子树那种情况才能造出节点，而完全不必知道它的父节点是谁。
和树里已有的值相等时，两个比较都不成立，什么也不改：这棵树不存重复值。
前序列表显示出形状。演示的头两行用同样的值、不同的顺序插入，得到两棵不同的树。按顺序插入 1、2、3、4，每个节点都成了前一个的右孩子——这棵树其实就是一条链表。

lineNotes.en: The first call turns root from None into the tree's first node; after that the same root comes back every time.
lineNotes.zh: 第一次调用把 root 从 None 变成树的第一个节点；此后每次交回来的都是同一个根。

lineNotes.en: The mirror image of the left case: insert into the right subtree and store it back.
lineNotes.zh: 左边那种情况的镜像：插进右子树，再存回来。

blurb.en: The same insert done by walking down the tree in a loop, keeping hold of the parent so the new node has somewhere to hang.
blurb.zh: 同样的插入改成用循环往下走，一路记住父节点，新节点才有地方挂。

en: The same problem as BST Insert (Recursive), solved by walking down the tree with a loop. node moves one level at a time, left or right by the same rule, until it falls off the tree into None - which is exactly where the new value belongs.

By then node is None and there is no way back up, so parent has been following one step behind. When the loop ends, parent is the node the new one hangs from, and comparing value with parent's value once more decides which side.

Two cases leave early. A duplicate value returns straight away without changing anything. And if the loop never ran at all, parent is still None: the tree was empty, and the new node becomes the root.
The preorder here uses a stack instead of recursion, in the same way as Tree Traversals (Explicit Stack), so nothing in this program calls itself.
zh: 与 「二叉搜索树插入（递归）」同一个问题，改成用循环沿树往下走。node 每次下降一层，按同样的规矩往左或往右，直到掉出树外、变成 None——新值该放的地方正是那里。
到那时 node 已经是 None，回不到上面去了，所以 parent 一直跟在后面一步。循环结束时，parent 就是新节点要挂上去的那个节点；再把 value 和 parent 的值比一次，决定挂在哪一边。
有两种情况提前离开。重复值直接返回，什么也不改。如果循环一次都没跑，parent 仍是 None：树原本是空的，新节点就成了根。
这里的前序用栈而不用递归，写法与 「树的遍历（显式栈）」相同，所以整个程序里没有东西调用自己。

lineNotes.en: parent is still None only if the loop never ran: the tree was empty.
lineNotes.zh: 只有循环一次没跑时 parent 才仍是 None：树原本是空的。

lineNotes.en: A duplicate: the tree is left exactly as it was.
lineNotes.zh: 重复值：树原样不动。

blurb.en: Look for a value by comparing it with one node at a time and going left or right - every step leaves a whole subtree unvisited.
blurb.zh: 每次只和一个节点比，然后往左或往右——每走一步，就有一整棵子树不用再看。

en: The tree is built with the recursive insert from BST Insert (Recursive) (recursion itself is on the Recursion page); the search itself is a plain loop.

At every node there are three outcomes: the node holds the target, the target is smaller, or it is larger. A smaller value can only be in the left subtree, so the whole right subtree is thrown away without being looked at - and the other way round for a larger one. Each step goes down one level and discards one subtree.
When node falls off the tree into None, there is nowhere left that the target could be, so the answer is False.
How much a step throws away depends on the tree's shape. In the last demo tree, built from 1 to 5 in order, every left subtree is empty, so looking for 6 visits every node.
zh: 树用 「二叉搜索树插入（递归）」里的递归 insert 建成（递归本身见「递归」一页）；查找本身是一个普通循环。
在每个节点上只有三种结果：这个节点就是目标；目标更小；目标更大。更小的值只可能在左子树里，所以整棵右子树连看都不用看就丢掉了——更大时反过来。每一步下降一层，丢掉一棵子树。
node 掉出树外变成 None 时，目标已经没有别的地方可能在了，答案就是 False。
每一步能丢掉多少，取决于树的形状。演示里最后那棵树按 1 到 5 的顺序建成，每棵左子树都是空的，所以找 6 要把每个节点都走一遍。

lineNotes.en: Found it: stop straight away, however much of the tree is left.
lineNotes.zh: 找到了：不管树还剩多少，立刻停下。

lineNotes.at: return [contains(root, query) for query in queries]
lineNotes.en: One tree, built once, answers every query.
lineNotes.zh: 树只建一次，回答所有查询。

run.expect:

65 False
20 True

[False]
[True, False]

blurb.en: Delete a leaf, a node with one child and a node with two - the last one by borrowing its inorder successor.
blurb.zh: 删叶子、删只有一个孩子的节点、删有两个孩子的节点——最后一种借用它的中序后继。

en: Recursion itself - base cases, the recursive step, the call stack - is on the Recursion page; here delete has the same shape as the recursive insert: find the value by going left or right, and store each changed subtree back on the way.

Once the value is found there are three cases. A leaf simply disappears. A node with one child is replaced by that child, which moves up to take its place under the parent. The code handles both at once: with no left child the right child moves up (None, for a leaf); with no right child the left one does.

A node with two children cannot just be removed. Its inorder successor - the smallest value in its right subtree, found by stepping right once and then left to the end - is copied into it, which keeps the ordering rule intact. The successor's old node is then deleted from the right subtree; it has no left child, so that deletion is one of the easy cases.

A value that is not in the tree ends at None and nothing changes. walk collects preorder and inorder in one pass: inorder stays sorted whatever is deleted, while preorder shows how the shape changed - deleting the root 50 puts 60 in its place.
zh: 递归本身（基例、递归步、调用栈）见「递归」一页；这里 delete 与递归插入同一个形状：往左或往右找到那个值，一路把改过的子树存回去。
找到之后有三种情形。叶子直接消失。只有一个孩子的节点由那个孩子顶替，挪上去挂到父节点下面。代码一次处理这两种：没有左孩子，右孩子顶上来（叶子的右孩子就是 None）；没有右孩子，左孩子顶上来。
有两个孩子的节点不能直接拿掉。它的中序后继——右子树里最小的值，往右走一步再一路向左走到头就是——被复制到它身上，排序规矩因此保持不变。然后从右子树里删掉后继原来的那个节点；它没有左孩子，所以这次删除属于前面的简单情形。
不在树里的值最后走到 None，什么也不变。walk 一趟同时收集前序和中序：不管删了什么，中序始终有序；前序则显示形状怎么变了——删掉根 50，60 就顶到了它的位置。

lineNotes.en: Only the value is copied; the node itself stays where it is, with both of its children.
lineNotes.zh: 只复制值；节点本身留在原处，两个孩子都不动。

lineNotes.en: No right child: the left subtree moves up in this node's place.
lineNotes.zh: 没有右孩子：左子树挪上来顶替这个节点。

blurb.en: The exam-paper layout: a value array and two pointer arrays, where a pointer is a row number and -1 means no child.
blurb.zh: 考卷上的存法：一个值数组加两个指针数组，指针就是行号，-1 表示没有孩子。

en: Exam pseudocode, and languages without objects, store a tree as parallel arrays: row i holds a value, the index of its left child and the index of its right child. A pointer is just an index, and -1 (called NULL here) means there is no child.

insert adds the new item at the end of all three arrays, so its index is the last one. The very first item is the root, at index 0. Any other item starts at the root with current and follows left or right pointers until it meets an empty one, then writes its own index there. Equal values go to the right.

The printed table is the kind of table exam questions ask you to fill in: start at row 0, follow the pointers, and you can redraw the tree. in_order walks it recursively (recursion itself is on the Recursion page), using indexes where the object version used attributes, and gives the names in alphabetical order.
The three arrays are module-level lists that insert changes directly, so this program holds exactly one tree - the price of the exam-style layout.
zh: 考卷上的伪代码、以及没有对象的语言，把树存成几个平行数组：第 i 行存一个值、它左孩子的下标、它右孩子的下标。指针就是下标，-1（这里叫 NULL）表示没有孩子。
insert 把新数据加到三个数组的末尾，所以它的下标是最后一个。第一个数据就是根，在下标 0。其余数据用 current 从根出发，顺着左指针或右指针往下走，遇到空指针就把自己的下标写进去。相等的值放右边。
打印出来的表，正是考题里常要你填的那种：从第 0 行出发顺着指针走，就能把树重新画出来。in_order 递归地走这棵树（递归本身见「递归」一页），对象版本用属性的地方这里用下标，走出来的名字按字母顺序排列。
三个数组是模块级的列表，insert 直接改它们，所以这个程序只能装一棵树——这是考卷式存法的代价。

lineNotes.en: The index of the row that was just added to the end.
lineNotes.zh: 刚加到末尾的那一行的下标。

lineNotes.en: The walk starts at row 0, the root.
lineNotes.zh: 从第 0 行、也就是根开始走。

blurb.en: A binary heap kept in a plain list: push lets the new item rise, pop lets the last item sink, and the smallest is always at index 0.
blurb.zh: 装在普通列表里的二叉堆：push 让新数据往上浮，pop 让最后一个往下沉，最小的永远在下标 0。

en: A binary heap is a complete binary tree stored in a plain list, with no pointers at all: the children of index i are at 2i + 1 and 2i + 2, and working that arithmetic backwards gives the index of its parent. In a min-heap every parent is no larger than its children, so the smallest item is always at index 0.
push puts the new item at the end, which keeps the tree complete but may break the parent rule. Sifting up repairs it: while the item is smaller than its parent, the two swap places.

pop takes the item at index 0. The last item fills the gap at the top, and sifting down moves it back down, each time swapping with the smaller of its children, until neither child is smaller. Popping an empty heap returns None - the convention for this program.

The printed lists are not sorted: [1, 3, 2, 5, 9, 8] only promises that every parent is no larger than its children. Each push or pop moves along one path between the top and the bottom and never looks at the rest of the list. Python's heapq module does these same two moves; Priority Queue with heapq uses it.
zh: 二叉堆是一棵装在普通列表里的完全二叉树，一根指针都没有：下标 i 的孩子在 2i + 1 和 2i + 2，把这道算术倒过来算，就得到父节点的下标。最小堆里每个父节点都不大于它的孩子，所以最小的数据永远在下标 0。
push 把新数据放在末尾，树仍然是完全的，但父子规矩可能被破坏。上浮负责修好它：只要这个数据比父节点小，两者就交换位置。
pop 取走下标 0 的数据。最后一个数据补到顶上的空位，下沉再把它挪下去：每次与两个孩子中较小的那个交换，直到两个孩子都不比它小。空堆上 pop 返回 None——这是本程序的约定。
打印出来的列表并不有序：[1, 3, 2, 5, 9, 8] 只保证每个父节点不大于它的孩子。每次 push 或 pop 只沿着顶到底之间的一条路径移动，列表的其余部分一眼都不看。Python 的 heapq 模块做的就是这两个动作；「用 heapq 做优先队列」用的就是它。

lineNotes.at: if child + 1 < len(heap) and heap[child + 1] < heap[child]:
lineNotes.en: Switch to the right child if there is one and it is smaller: the item must swap with the smaller child, or the rule breaks at once.
lineNotes.zh: 有右孩子且它更小，就换成右孩子：必须与较小的孩子交换，否则规矩当场就破了。

lineNotes.en: Taking the last item off keeps the tree complete; it then goes in at the top and sinks.
lineNotes.zh: 从末尾拿走一个，树仍然是完全的；它再放到顶上往下沉。

title.zh: 用 heapq 做优先队列

blurb.en: heapq keeps the smallest entry on top; a (priority, seq, task) tuple serves equal priorities first come, first served and never compares two tasks.
blurb.zh: heapq 让最小的一项永远在顶上；(priority, seq, task) 元组让同优先级的先来先服务，也让两个任务永远不必互相比较。

en: heapq turns a plain list into a min-heap - the same sifting up and down written out in Min-Heap by Hand. heappush adds an item and heappop removes the smallest.

Tuples are compared item by item, so an entry of (priority, seq, task) is ordered by priority first. seq counts arrivals: when two priorities are equal, the earlier arrival has the smaller seq and comes out first - first come, first served.

seq also means that the tasks themselves are never compared, because no two entries share a seq. That matters: without it, two tasks with the same priority would be compared directly, and tasks that cannot be compared, such as dictionaries, raise TypeError - the demo builds exactly such a heap to show it.
serve on an empty queue returns None, the same convention as Priority Queue by Scanning.
zh: heapq 把一个普通列表变成最小堆——做的就是 「手写最小堆」里写出来的上浮和下沉。heappush 加入一项，heappop 取走最小的一项。
元组逐项比较，所以 (priority, seq, task) 先按优先级排。seq 数的是到达的先后：优先级相等时，先到的 seq 更小、先出来——先来先服务。
有了 seq，任务本身也就永远不会被比较，因为没有两项的 seq 相同。这一点要紧：没有它，同优先级的两个任务会被直接拿来比较，而无法比较的任务（比如字典）会抛 TypeError——演示里特意建了这样一个堆来看它发生。
空队列上 serve 返回 None，与 「扫描取最小的优先队列」的约定相同。

lineNotes.en: Equal priorities and no seq: the tuples tie on their first item, so Python moves on to compare the two dictionaries - and cannot.
lineNotes.zh: 优先级相等又没有 seq：两个元组第一项打平，Python 接着去比两个字典——比不了。

lineNotes.en: Only the task goes back; the priority and the arrival number were for the heap's use.
lineNotes.zh: 只交回任务；优先级和到达序号是给堆用的。

title.zh: 扫描取最小的优先队列

blurb.en: The same queue on a plain list: adding is just an append, and every serve looks through the whole list for the smallest priority.
blurb.zh: 同一个队列装在普通列表里：加入只是 append，每次出队都把整个列表看一遍，找优先级最小的。

en: The same queue as Priority Queue with heapq, with the same add and serve, but kept in a plain list in the order the tasks arrived. add only appends; all the work happens in serve.

serve scans the whole list, remembering the position of the smallest priority seen so far. Only a strictly smaller priority replaces it, so among equal priorities the first one - the earliest arrival - wins, and no arrival number is needed.

Side by side: here adding costs nothing and every serve looks at every waiting task, while the heap version does a little work on both, along one path of the heap each time. For a handful of tasks either is fine.
zh: 与 「用 heapq 做优先队列」同一个队列，add 和 serve 也一样，只是按任务到达的顺序存在普通列表里。add 只管 append；活都在 serve 里干。
serve 把整个列表扫一遍，记住目前见过的优先级最小的那一项的位置。只有严格更小的优先级才替换它，所以同优先级里排在最前的——最早到的——胜出，用不着到达序号。
并排看：这里加入不花力气，每次出队却要看遍所有等着的任务；堆版本两头都做一点活，每次只沿着堆里的一条路径。任务只有几个时，两种都行。

lineNotes.en: Start by assuming the first task is the best; the loop then only has to look at the rest.
lineNotes.zh: 先假定第一个任务最好；循环只需看剩下的。

lineNotes.en: Stored in arrival order, which is what makes ties come out first come, first served.
lineNotes.zh: 按到达顺序存放——并列时先来先服务靠的就是它。

blurb.en: Read reverse Polish notation with a stack of trees, then evaluate the finished tree and print it with brackets, both recursively.
blurb.zh: 用一个装树的栈读逆波兰记号，建好的树再递归求值、带括号打印出来。

en: Recursion itself - base cases, the recursive step, the call stack - is on the Recursion page; here it is used to walk the finished tree. An expression tree stores a calculation: each leaf is a number, and each inner node is an operator whose two children are its operands.

Reading reverse Polish notation with a stack is the subject of the RPN evaluator on the stacks-and-queues page. Here the same stack builds a tree instead of a number: a number becomes a leaf; an operator takes the top two trees as its children, and the new, bigger tree goes back on the stack. At the end exactly one tree is left - the whole expression.

evaluate works from the bottom up: a leaf is its own value; otherwise both children are evaluated and combined with the operator. infix follows the same shape to print the tree, putting brackets around every operation so the order of evaluation shows without any precedence rules.
The two subtractions in the demo contain the same tokens in a different order and build different trees; the brackets show which subtraction happens first.
zh: 递归本身（基例、递归步、调用栈）见「递归」一页；这里用它来走建好的树。表达式树存的是一道算式：每片叶子是一个数，每个内部节点是一个运算符，它的两个孩子就是两个操作数。
用栈读逆波兰记号，是栈与队列那一页里逆波兰求值程序的主题。这里同一个栈建的是树而不是数：数变成叶子；运算符把栈顶的两棵树收作自己的孩子，新的、更大的树再压回栈里。最后栈里恰好剩一棵树——整个表达式。
evaluate 自底向上：叶子的值就是它自己；否则先算出两个孩子，再用运算符合起来。infix 顺着同样的形状把树打印出来，每一步运算都套上括号，不用任何优先级规则就看得出先算什么。
演示里那两道减法用的记号相同、顺序不同，建出两棵不同的树；括号显示出先做的是哪一次减法。

lineNotes.en: A number becomes a leaf: a node with no children.
lineNotes.zh: 数变成叶子：一个没有孩子的节点。

lineNotes.en: node.value is an operator string here, so it can be joined straight in; a leaf's number is turned into a string by the line above.
lineNotes.zh: 这里的 node.value 是运算符字符串，可以直接拼进去；叶子的数由上面那一行转成字符串。
